sources.snippet: Blueprint Universal AI Orchestration Contract Blueprint is the industry-standard specification format for multi-agent AI execution. Any flagship model — Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek — can parse, execute, and hand off Blueprint tasks with zero ambiguity.

sources.title: AI that Generates Construction Blueprints
sources.snippet: What is Blueprints AI? Blueprints AI is AI that generates code-compliant construction documents from plain-language descriptions, sketches, or existing design files. Architects, developers, and design-build firms use it to compress drafting timelines from months to hours while keeping licensed professionals in control of final review and sealing.
